summary: Jinshu 80 units s0200–s0221 support Xie Wan’s 升平三年 defeat (AD 359), Wang Xizhi’s death age of 59 sui without a source year, Wang Ningzhi’s killing and Sun En’s Kuaiji attack in 隆安三年 (AD 399), and Wang Huizhi’s staff service under Grand Marshal Huan Wen during 興寧–寧康 (AD 363–373). They do not support AD 361 as Xizhi’s death or honor year (年五十九卒 has no reign year; 真誥’s 升平五年 competes with other witnesses), the invented 340–361 window on 玄之早卒, the 355–399 career span on 子 凝之 / 仕歷…, or dating 車騎桓沖 and Huizhi’s cavalry post to 373–384 (in 寧康元年 Chong was 中軍將軍; 車騎 begins 寧康三年 / 太元元年). Active hints must follow those corrections.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi's death, which this biography dates only by age fifty-nine.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p061. s0202 says 年五十九卒 and gives no ruler, era, or year. AD 361 is not a conversion of this passage; it imports 真誥’s 升平五年辛酉 reading and treats it as the unique year. Competing 321–379 and other reconstructions remain live. Keep the age; do not certify a Western death year from the age clause alone.

itemChecks.event: The heading that names Wang Ningzhi as Xizhi's son, not a dated office career.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p071. s0204 is only 子 凝之; s0207 lists 江州刺史、左將軍、會稽內史 with no reign year. The 355–399 interval is not uncertainty about one event: 355 is not Ningzhi’s own dated act in these units (it tracks Xizhi’s 永和十一年 retirement, elsewhere in the chapter), and 399 is his later death. A dynasty-length activity window is forbidden here.

evidence.quote: 仕歷江州刺史、左將軍、會稽內史

itemChecks.event: Wang Ningzhi's presence at Kuaiji during Sun En's attack.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p071. 孫恩之攻會稽 is the same attack as 晉書安帝紀 隆安三年十一月甲寅, 妖賊孫恩陷會稽, 內史王凝之死之. 隆安 is Andi; year 3 is the conventional AD 399 label. The 十一月甲寅 day is December in that year, not a New Year boundary; Julian (Academia Sinica default before 1582) and proleptic Gregorian both stay AD 399. Year precision is justified.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xuanzhi's early death, which the source leaves undated.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p072. 玄之早卒 states manner only. AD 340 and 361 are invented endpoints (a guessed birth band and the father’s putative death). That is not a genuine uncertainty window. The death stays unresolved, not a closed Western interval.

itemChecks.event: Sun En's attack on Kuaiji.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p073. The named attack is 隆安三年十一月甲寅 in the Andi annals. Conventional 隆安三年 is AD 399; the eleventh-month day does not cross into another Western year under Julian or proleptic Gregorian.

itemChecks.event: Wang Huizhi's service as army adviser to Grand Marshal Huan Wen.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p074. 為大司馬桓溫參軍 is undated; 大司馬 names the office Wen held from 哀帝 興寧元年五月 (annals: 加征西大將軍桓溫…大司馬) to death 孝武帝 寧康元年七月己亥. Those are onOrAfter 363 and onOrBefore 373, not after 363. The interval is uncertainty about when Huizhi served inside that marshalship, not a claim he held the staff post in every year of the reign.

itemChecks.event: Wang Huizhi's service as cavalry adviser to Huan Chong while Chong was General of Chariot and Cavalry.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p074. 又為車騎桓沖騎兵參軍 dates the post by Chong’s 車騎 title, not by Wen’s death. In 寧康元年 Chong was made 中軍將軍, not 車騎. 車騎 begins 寧康三年 in Jinshu 74 (AD 375) or 太元元年 in the Xiaowu annals (AD 376). Starting the window in 373 invents an endpoint before the title. Huizhi’s service is only sometime while Chong was 車騎, not 373–384 activity.

evidence.quote: 又為車騎桓沖騎兵參軍

itemChecks.event: Huan Wen holding the title Grand Marshal in the Huizhi staff notice.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p075. This chapter calls him 大司馬桓溫. Annals place the title from 興寧元年五月 (AD 363) to his death as 大司馬 in 寧康元年七月 (AD 373). The closed interval is that office tenure, not a guessed second bound.

itemChecks.event: Huan Chong holding the title General of Chariot and Cavalry in the Huizhi staff notice.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p076. 車騎桓沖 is the title used to identify him. He did not hold 車騎 in 373 (then 中軍將軍). Biography: 甯康三年…車騎將軍; annals: 太元元年…中軍將軍桓沖爲車騎將軍. He still held 車騎 at death 太元九年二月辛巳 (AD 384), so the end year is usable, but the 373 start is false. Preserve 375 versus 376; do not keep 373–384.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xuanzhi's death described only as dying young.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p072. Death as 早卒 is in s0206; the 340–361 dateContext is not. Inclusive age is absent, and a descendant’s or father’s later date must not supply Xuanzhi’s death year. Leave the death undated/unresolved.

itemChecks.event: Wang Huizhi holding the army-adviser post under Grand Marshal Huan Wen.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p074. The office 大司馬參軍 is explicit; its Western bounds are the marshalship 興寧元年五月–寧康元年七月 (AD 363–373). That window is uncertainty about the undated appointment, not activity through a whole dynasty.

itemChecks.event: Wang Huizhi holding the cavalry-adviser post under Huan Chong as 車騎.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p074. The office 騎兵參軍 is explicit; dating it 373–384 uses Chong’s succession year, when he was 中軍將軍. The title in the passage is 車騎, which starts 375 or 376. Do not keep 373 as the first year of this office.

itemChecks.event: Huan Wen holding the office of Grand Marshal.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p075. The chapter attests the title 大司馬; Mu/Ai/Xiaowu annals convert 興寧元年五月 accession to the office and 寧康元年七月 death still as 大司馬. Conventional labels are AD 363 and 373; July 寧康元年 remains 373 in Julian and proleptic Gregorian.

itemChecks.event: Huan Chong holding the office of General of Chariot and Cavalry.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p076. 車騎 is attested here, but 373–384 is not that tenure. 寧康元年 he is 中軍將軍; 車騎 is 甯康三年 or 太元元年; death as 車騎 is 太元九年二月辛巳. Replace 373–384 with bounds from 375/376, and keep the 375 versus 376 clash visible.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi's age of fifty-nine sui at death.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p061. 年五十九卒 is an explicit sui age at death. Reckoning is preserved; this check does not convert the age into a birth year.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi's death at fifty-nine sui.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p061. Death and age 59 are explicit; westernYear 361 is not in s0202. 真誥 gives 升平五年辛酉, but that is an external witness, not this sentence, and other year-pairs remain. Do not collapse the age notice into a single AD death year.

itemChecks.event: The court's posthumous award of 金紫光祿大夫 to Wang Xizhi after his death.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p061. 贈金紫光祿大夫 is a death-notice honor, not living office. It must stay a separate posthumous honor (retrospective if kept as later reception) and must not feed life dates. AD 361 is the same unsupported import as the death year; the source does not date the gift.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi as recipient when his sons declined the posthumous honor.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p061 (recipient). 諸子遵父先旨，固讓不受 follows the undated death/gift; it is not an independent AD 361 life event and must not be used as an active date. Keep the refusal as a sequenced reception/honor event; drop the invented year.

evidence.quote: 諸子遵父先旨，固讓不受

itemChecks.event: Xie Wan's defeat after ignoring Wang Xizhi's advice.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p066. 萬不能用，果敗 is the northern failure after 萬後為豫州都督. 穆帝紀 升平三年冬十月: 遣西中郎將謝萬次下蔡…王師敗績. 升平 is Mudi; year 3 is the conventional AD 359 label. October is not a New Year boundary. Year precision is justified.

itemChecks.event: Wang Ningzhi's refusal to prepare defenses when Sun En attacked Kuaiji.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p071. The refusal is tied to 孫恩之攻會稽, dated 隆安三年十一月 in the Andi annals, conventional AD 399. Same year-boundary reasoning as claim-483.

itemChecks.event: Wang Ningzhi's killing by Sun En at Kuaiji.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p071. 遂為孫所害 is the same death as 安帝紀 隆安三年十一月甲寅…內史王凝之死之. Killer and place match the chapter. Western year AD 399; the dated day stays in 399 under Julian and proleptic Gregorian.

itemChecks.event: Sun En's attack on Kuaiji in which Wang Ningzhi was killed.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p073. Attacker role is explicit in 孫恩之攻會稽 and 遂為孫所害. Annals date the fall of Kuaiji to 隆安三年十一月甲寅, AD 399.

itemChecks.event: Wang Ningzhi's undated provincial offices plus his killing at Kuaiji; the 355-399 office span is not his own dated event.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p071. AD 399 killed at Kuaiji matches 遂為孫所害 / 隆安三年. AD 355–399 offices has no personal dated office event: 仕歷… is undated, and 355 is not Ningzhi’s. Active hints must not turn an office list into a dynasty-long career window.

evidence.quote: 仕歷江州刺史、左將軍、會稽內史

itemChecks.event: Wang Xuanzhi's early death, which the hint wrongly dates as AD 340-361 activity.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p072. 早卒 is not a dated active career. 340–361 are invented and must not appear as an active-date hint. Death remains unresolved.

itemChecks.event: Sun En's attack on Kuaiji.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p073. The hint names his own 隆安三年 attack, conventional AD 399, matching s0209 and the Andi annal.

itemChecks.event: Wang Huizhi's two staff posts; the Huan Chong cavalry hint uses a false 373 start.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p074. AD 363–373 adviser to Huan Wen is the marshalship window supported above. AD 373–384 cavalry adviser to Huan Chong is not: 車騎 had not begun in 373. Synchronize hints with the 車騎 title dates (375/376–onOrBefore 384), not Wen’s death year.

evidence.quote: 又為車騎桓沖騎兵參軍

itemChecks.event: Huan Wen serving as Grand Marshal.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p075. The hint matches the converted 大司馬 tenure 興寧元年–寧康元年 (AD 363–373) used to identify him in s0214.

itemChecks.event: Huan Chong as General of Chariot and Cavalry with Huizhi on staff; 373 is not that title's first year.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p076. AD 373–384 as Cavalry General restates the false 車騎 start. In 373 he was 中軍將軍. Do not use that span as an active hint.

personChecks.reason: Owned items plus s0204–s0211 give Ningzhi as Xizhi’s son, undated offices (江州刺史、左將軍、會稽內史), Five-Pecks devotion, refusal to prepare, and death at Kuaiji when Sun En attacked. The only converted personal date is 隆安三年 / AD 399. claim-482 and the 355–399 office hint invent a career window from another man’s 355 retirement and from the death year. No birth or age is in these units. Chronology is incoherent until the 355–399 span is removed and offices stay undated.

evidence.quote: 仕歷江州刺史、左將軍、會稽內史

personChecks.reason: The only personal event in the owned units is 玄之早卒. No birth, age, or source year. claim-484, claim-521, and the active hint assign AD 340–361 from the father’s putative lifespan, not from Xuanzhi’s own notice. That is false precision around an unresolved death.

In this chapter Sun En’s own dated event is the Kuaiji attack that killed Ningzhi. Annals convert it to 隆安三年十一月 / AD 399. No birth or death for En appears in the owned units, and none should be invented from later rebellion years. The 399 attack hint matches the supported claims.

s0212–s0221 attest Huizhi as 大司馬桓溫參軍 then 車騎桓沖騎兵參軍, with undated anecdotes under Chong. The Wen staff window 363–373 is supportable from the marshal title. The Chong staff dates 373–384 are not, because 車騎 starts later. No birth, death, or age is in the owned units (later-chapter death is outside this job). Person chronology is split: keep the Wen bounds; repair the 車騎 bounds.

evidence.quote: 又為車騎桓沖騎兵參軍

personChecks.reason: This chapter only identifies Huan Wen as 大司馬 in Huizhi’s staff notice. That title’s tenure 興寧元年五月–寧康元年七月 is AD 363–373 from the annals. No death or birth is claimed here from a later honor, and the active hint matches the office. Endpoints are Wen’s own office events, not Huizhi’s.

The chapter names Chong 車騎 and shows Huizhi on that staff (s0215, s0221). His 車騎 tenure is not 373–384: 373 is the 中軍將軍 succession after Wen; 車騎 is 375 or 376; death as 車騎 is 太元九年 / AD 384. claim-489, claim-530, and the active hint all use the wrong start. Preserve the 375/376 disagreement instead of locking 373.

findings.problem: s0202–s0203 give Wang Xizhi’s death at 59 sui, a same-sentence 贈金紫光祿大夫, and the sons’ refusal, with no reign year. AD 361 is imported (真誥 升平五年 is one later witness among others) and then reused as a life/honor year.
findings.action: Keep age 59 sui at death. Remove westernYear AD 361 from the death, the gift, and the sons’ refusal. Leave those events unresolved as to year, or record competing witnesses without choosing one. Keep the gift and refusal as posthumous honor/reception sequenced after death, not as living activity or active hints.

findings.problem: Ningzhi’s name heading and undated 仕歷 offices were given a 355–399 activity window. 355 is not his event; 399 is his death year from Sun En, not the start or span of every office.
findings.action: Drop the 355–399 interval on the son-heading attestation. Leave 江州刺史、左將軍、會稽內史 undated. Keep AD 399 only on the Kuaiji attack, the refused defense, and the killing. Rewrite hints to the 399 death/attack, not ‘AD 355–399 offices’.

findings.problem: 玄之早卒 was given an invented AD 340–361 death window and an active hint, using the father’s putative dates rather than Xuanzhi’s own undated death.
findings.action: Keep the death as died-young / 早卒 with unresolved:true and a reason that the source has no year. Remove both Western endpoints and the 340–361 hint. Do not infer a birth year.

findings.problem: 車騎桓沖 and Huizhi’s 騎兵參軍 were dated 373–384. In 寧康元年 Chong was 中軍將軍; 車騎 begins 甯康三年 (375) in the biography or 太元元年 (376) in the annals, and he still held 車騎 at death in 太元九年 (384).
findings.action: Replace the 373 start. For Chong’s 車騎 office use onOrAfter 375 with the 376 annal as a competing first year, and onOrBefore 384 from the death still as 車騎. For Huizhi’s cavalry post use the same title-based bounds as uncertainty, not a full-tenure activity span. Keep Huizhi’s 363–373 Wen adviser hint; delete 373–384 from p074 and p076 hints.

references.title: 晉書/卷008 穆帝紀 升平三年
references.quote: 冬十月慕容儁寇東阿，遣西中郎將謝萬次下蔡，北中郎將郗曇次高平以擊之，王師敗績。
references.reason: Primary annal that converts this chapter’s 果敗 to 升平三年冬十月, conventional AD 359.

references.title: 晉書/卷008 哀帝紀 興寧元年
references.quote: 五月，加征西大將軍桓溫侍中、大司馬、都督中外諸軍事、錄尚書事、假黃鉞。
references.reason: Primary annal for Huan Wen becoming 大司馬 in 興寧元年五月, conventional AD 363 (onOrAfter 363).

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀 寧康元年
references.quote: 秋七月己亥，使持節、侍中、都督中外諸軍事、丞相、錄尚書、大司馬、揚州牧、平北將軍、徐兗二州刺史、南郡公桓溫薨。
references.reason: Primary annal for Wen’s death still as 大司馬 in 寧康元年七月, conventional AD 373.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀 寧康元年
references.quote: 以江州刺史桓沖爲中軍將軍、都督揚豫江三州諸軍事、揚州刺史，鎮姑孰。
references.reason: Shows Chong’s 373 succession title was 中軍將軍, so 車騎 cannot start in 373.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀 太元元年
references.quote: 中軍將軍桓沖爲車騎將軍
references.reason: Annal witness that Chong became 車騎 in 太元元年 (AD 376), competing with the 甯康三年 biography date.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀 太元九年
references.quote: 二月辛巳，使持節、都督荊江梁寧益交廣七州諸軍事、車騎將軍、荊州刺史桓沖卒。
references.reason: Primary annal that Chong still held 車騎 at death in 太元九年二月, conventional AD 384.

references.title: 晉書/卷010 安帝紀 隆安三年
references.quote: 十一月甲寅，妖賊孫恩陷會稽，內史王凝之死之
references.reason: Primary annal converting 孫恩之攻會稽 and 遂為孫所害 to 隆安三年十一月甲寅, conventional AD 399.

references.title: 晉書/卷074 桓沖傳
references.quote: 於是改授都督徐兗豫青揚五州之六郡軍事、車騎將軍、徐州刺史
references.reason: Biography witness that Chong received 車騎 in 甯康三年 (AD 375), not in 373.

references.title: 真誥/卷016 闡幽微第二
references.quote: 至升平五年辛酉歲亡，年五十九。
references.reason: External competing witness for Xizhi’s death year; it is not in Jinshu 80 and must not be treated as the unique conversion of 年五十九卒.

references.title: 中央研究院 兩千年中西曆轉換
references.quote: 在此之前的西曆稱為儒略(Julian)曆
references.reason: Documents the converter’s Julian default before 1582. The month/day annals used here (十月, 十一月, 五月, 七月, 二月) do not sit on a New Year seam that would change the AD year; year labels are also stated as proleptic Gregorian where a day is known.
